response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced full-stack/web developer with strong DLang, Node.js, and TypeScript expertise, but has minimal recent C++ experience (only a brief stint at National Instruments over a decade ago) and no evidence of the required industrial automation, IEC 62443 security standards, message brokers, MQTT, or IoT protocol experience central to this role.
strengths: Deep, broad software engineering experience (15+ years) across multiple domains
Demonstrated experience with networked/async systems and performance-focused development (DLang, fibers, async I/O)
Strong communication, mentoring, and community involvement (talks, workshops, open source)
concerns: C++ experience is minimal and outdated (last significant use ~2015 at National Instruments)
No evidence of IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity experience
No mention of MQTT, message brokers, UML, or industrial automation/IoT protocols required for the role
